name: Microsoft GraphRAG and LazyGraphRAG
tier_reason: GraphRAG reference implementation; target of seed inversion hypothesis (Master Prompt 10.5)
release_cadence: Minor releases roughly every 2-5 weeks (v3.1.1 2026-07-18, v3.1.2 2026-08-21, v3.2.0 2026-09-24, v3.3.0 2026-10-08); internals not semver-bound
redistribution_notes: MIT permits embedding and OEM; transitive dependency and model licences (graspologic-native, LiteLLM, spaCy models) not audited.
community_vs_enterprise: Single OSS edition; LazyGraphRAG is offered via Microsoft Discovery / Azure Local preview (commercial Azure surfaces), not confirmed in the OSS repo.
resolution_note: LazyGraphRAG announced 2024-11-25 and promised for the library; no LazyGraphRAG code exists in the v3.3.0 tree; treated as announced/hosted, not shipped OSS. Repo describes itself as a research platform.
action_reason: Reference GraphRAG system; independent benchmarks available.
decision_summary: EXPERIMENT permission-scoped on-demand community reports natively; REUSE hierarchical Leiden; BUILD ACL-aware summaries, provenance-driven incremental update and benchmark harness; REJECT as core extraction pipeline; DEFER LazyGraphRAG/DRIFT.

name: LightRAG
tier_reason: Dual-level graph retrieval; incremental-update pattern cited in seed inversion hypothesis; very high adoption
members: Storage adapters (Neo4j, Memgraph, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, OpenSearch, Milvus, Qdrant, Faiss)
owner: HKUDS (GitHub organisation); paper authors Guo, Xia, Yu, Ao, Huang
release_cadence: Frequent: roughly every 1-4 weeks incl. release candidates (v1.5.6 2026-08-06, v1.5.7rc1 2026-08-17, v1.5.7 2026-09-02)
redistribution_notes: MIT permits embedding and OEM; optional parsers (MinerU, Docling) and model weights carry separate licences, not reviewed.
community_vs_enterprise: Single OSS edition; no commercial tier identified.
resolution_note: Name collisions with forks (e.g. LLTrs/LightRAG, fpdb/LightRAG); registry means HKUDS/LightRAG. SECURITY.md supported-versions table is stale (lists 1.3.x).
action_reason: High-adoption GraphRAG alternative with Neo4j/Memgraph storage and incremental update.
decision_summary: EXPERIMENT dual-level (entity + relation-theme) retrieval natively; BUILD provenance-driven delete/update and ACL-scoped descriptions; INTEGRATE strong local embedder and reranker; REJECT as embedded dependency (no ACL, loose cross-store consistency).

name: HippoRAG and HippoRAG 2
tier_reason: PPR-based associative memory retrieval; best-measured multi-hop gains among graph methods at near-vanilla query cost
latest_version: v1.0.0 (only tagged release, HippoRAG v1 code); main package 2.0.0a5 at commit d5c8329 (HippoRAG 2)
release_cadence: One tagged release; main receives commits roughly weekly in 2026-09/10; v2 never tagged
redistribution_notes: MIT permits embedding; embedding/LLM model weights (e.g. NV-Embed-v2) have separate licences, not reviewed.
resolution_note: Version trap: tag v1.0.0 holds HippoRAG v1 code; HippoRAG 2 exists only on main as alpha 2.0.0a5. Pinned to commit d5c8329.
action_reason: Primary PPR-based retrieval reference; covers both papers.
decision_summary: EXPERIMENT PPR retrieval natively over BL-16 with ACL-masked propagation; REUSE PPR algorithm; EXPERIMENT soft synonym edges as proposals only; REJECT embedding upstream alpha code and its unauthenticated MCP server.
